name: Gerard Wertheimer

controls.name: Chanel Limited (Chanel Group; privately held, HQ London)
Chanel 2025 results: revenue $19.3B (+2%), operating profit $4.7B (+5%); CEO Leena Nair
St. Supery Estate Vineyards & Winery (Napa) — Chanel-owned since 2015; bought Rudd Estate/Crossroads (Oakville, 65 acres) April 2026, price undisclosed
Chateau Rauzan-Segla (Margaux), Chateau Canon & Chateau Berliquet (Saint-Emilion), Domaine de l'Ile (Porquerolles), negociant Ulysse Cazabonne, retailer Lavinia
Charvet (Paris shirtmaker, founded 1838) — acquired by Chanel July 2026; terms undisclosed
Grey Mer (Italian footwear maker) — Chanel majority stake (2025)

stakes.name: The Row (Olsen sisters' fashion label) — minority stake via Mousse Partners at ~$1B valuation (Sept 2024); Olsens retain control
Kross Manufacture (watch manufacturing) — Chanel 30% minority stake
Mantero Seta (Italian silk maker) — Chanel 35% stake
Leo France (Italian costume jewelry/metal accessories) — Chanel 20% stake

vehicles.name: Mousse Partners
vehicles.notes: Wertheimer family holding/investment office; receives Chanel dividends ($5.8B for FY2025; $15.1B since 2017); invests in real estate, private equity, healthcare and fashion ventures (e.g. The Row). Not found on EDGAR company search.

privateDeals.what: Mousse Partners co-invests in The Row minority stake alongside Bettencourt Meyers' Tethys Invest (~$1B valuation)
Chanel's St. Supery buys Rudd Estate and Crossroads brand, Oakville, Napa (price undisclosed)

realEstate.type: primary residence (Fortune reported he lives in Geneva)

trophies.what: Wertheimer et Frere — Thoroughbred racing & breeding stable co-owned by Alain and Gerard; Haras de Saint-Leonard stud in Normandy (Calvados) plus a U.S. stud; runners in 2025 Prix du Jockey Club and Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe
Bordeaux/Provence/Napa wine estates owned via Chanel (Rauzan-Segla, Canon, Berliquet, Domaine de l'Ile, St. Supery)

watch.what: Chanel dividend flow to Mousse Partners — more than half of $5.8B FY2025 payout expected to be distributed during 2026
Chanel bolt-on acquisitions of European ateliers/suppliers (Charvet July 2026, Kross Jan 2026) — watch for further supplier deals
Chanel trading momentum under Matthieu Blazy (Americas +7.2% in 2025, Asia-Pacific -0.8%)
Wertheimer et Frere runners in major autumn Group 1 races (stable ran two in the 2025 Arc)
